When requests are tracked and SLAs are visible, it's easier to make sure requesters aren't left wondering what happened to their request.
And when a team member is out of the office, the rest of the team can see the ticket history and notes and pick up where things left off.
There's also a clear record of what has already been communicated and what work has been completed.
That makes handoffs easier and reduces the chance that someone has to start over because the history was sitting in one person's inbox.
The goal isn't to make team members work harder.
It's to make it easier for them to do the work they're already trying to do.
